subject: Signal and System
questionText:
The input and output of a continuous time system are
respectively denoted by x(t) and y(t) which of the
following descriptions corresponds to a causal
system?
 (a)
y(t) = x(t – 2) + x(t + 4)
(b)
y(t) = x(t – 4).x (t + 1)
(c)
y(t) = (t + 4) .x (t – 1)
(d)
y(t) = (t + 5).x (t + 5)
explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-07 (Types of System).
